Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, stands proudly, his eyes shining with tears. He is presented with a certificate and a gold medal.

OFFICIAL
Ladies and gentlemen, please welcome the newest world record holder, GEORGE, for being the oldest human to ever live!

The room erupts in applause as George smiles, his face etched with joy and gratitude.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George lies in bed, his eyes fixed on the ceiling. He takes a deep breath, and his mind begins to wander back to his youth. He recalls a theory he read on the internet, "Quantum Immortality".

GEORGE (V.O)
I remember reading about this theory, Quantum Immortality. It said that, according to the Many-Worlds Interpretation of Quantum Mechanics, every time a decision is made, the universe splits into multiple parallel universes, each with a different outcome. And in one of those universes, I would have lived forever.

George's eyes glaze over as he becomes lost in thought.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
But what if I'm not just living in one universe? What if I'm living in all of them? What if I'm the only one who's aware of it?

George's voice becomes a whisper, his words barely audible.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
I've been living for 127 years, but what if I'm not just living for 127 years? What if I'm living for an infinite number of years, trapped in a never-ending cycle of parallel universes?

George's eyes widen, and his face contorts in a mixture of fear and despair.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
What if I'm not just a human being? What if I'm a quantum entity, existing in multiple dimensions, forever doomed to repeat the same cycle of life and death?

George's body begins to shake, and he starts to sob uncontrollably.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
I don't want to live forever! I don't want to be trapped in this never-ending cycle! I want to die!

The camera zooms in on George's face, his eyes wild and desperate.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
But what if I'm not allowed to die? What if I'm stuck in this quantum purgatory, forever doomed to relive the same moments, the same decisions, the same life?

George's body convulses, and he screams at the top of his lungs.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
AHHHHHHHHH!

The camera fades to black as George's mind shatters, consumed by the crushing weight of his own quantum immortality.

FADE OUT.
